name: rowsmith-mcp

tools.name: generate_test_data
tools.description: Generate realistic fake test data (CSV, JSON or SQL INSERTs) from a table schema. Use it first, when you need rows for fixtures, seed data or tests (list_column_types gives each type's options). Or pass schema (JSON Schema, e.g. a Pydantic or Zod export, or an OpenAPI component) instead of columns; unmappable fields are named. Next: invalid_values for values your code should reject. Free and rate-limited: up to 500 rows and 50 columns per call. No real person's data is used as input and no record is derived from a real person; emails, phones, card numbers, SSN-shaped and IBAN-shaped values come only from reserved or invalid ranges. The same schema and seed give byte-identical output for the same generator version (sent as x-generator-version). For more than about 50 rows, pass output_path to write a file instead of returning the data. The result gives the output's sha256 and ends with a curl that regenerates the same bytes. Send schemas only, never real data.

name.description: Column name: lowercase letters, digits and _

type.description: One of: uuid, sequence (start, step, prefix, pad), integer (min, max), decimal (min, max, scale), boolean (p_true), enum (values, weights), date (from, to: YYYY-MM-DD), datetime (from, to), first_name, last_name, full_name, email, phone, test_card, ssn_invalid, iban_invalid, text (min_words, max_words). Every column also takes null_rate.

schema.description: Instead of columns: a JSON Schema object, or {openapi: <document>, component: <name>}

seed.description: Seed; the same schema and seed give identical output for the same generator version (default 1)

table.description: Table name, used in SQL output (default data)

output_path.description: Write the data to this file instead of returning it (use for more than about 50 rows). Must be inside the working directory, or inside ROWSMITH_OUT_DIR when set; no '..' segments

overwrite.description: Replace output_path if it already exists (default false)

chaos.description: Deliberate misbehaviour for testing error handling

tools.name: list_column_types
tools.description: List the supported column types and the options each accepts. Use it before generate_test_data when you need a type's options.

tools.name: invalid_values
tools.description: Deliberately invalid TEST DATA values (malformed emails, declining or Luhn-invalid card numbers, malformed addresses, Unicode edge cases, invalid IBAN and SSN shapes), each with the reason it is invalid. Same seed, same output for the same catalogue version. Use it after generate_test_data, to test that your validation rejects bad input.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, e.g. value,reason

chaos.description: Deliberate misbehaviour for testing error handling
